scope.summary: MCP client config snippets proven against real client binaries: scripts/rig/client_snippets.py launches each available client with the documented snippet, captures the server-side stdio trace and records client version, launch command, transport, tools_list_sha256 (canonical JSON of the served tools/list), exit status. Unavailable clients each have one blocked child bead blocking R.1 (.5.2): oraclemcp-a49ff cursor-agent, oraclemcp-kpaq3 VS Code 'code', oraclemcp-h7rfn Gemini (tier refused). Commit 2ca3ff68.
out_of_scope: Client versions other than those recorded (bead no-claim).
